analyst.summary: Granules India has genuinely re-accelerated and improved in quality over the past year — revenue up 22% and profit up 60% in the latest quarter, driven by a structural shift toward higher-margin complex generics (now half the finished-dosage mix) and a sharply strengthened, now nearly debt-free balance sheet. A new USFDA exclusivity win adds a near-term catalyst. At ~37x earnings we rate it a Hold: the trailing 3-year growth figure understates where the business is now, but the price already reflects much of the recent improvement.
